entries.title: Chennai housewife earns by filming chores for robot training data #tesla #aichoretraining #robotics
entries.summary: A housewife in Tamil Nadu earns 250 rupees per hour filming everyday household chores for AI training data used by Tesla and Figure to teach home robots fine motor skills. This highlights a growing AI data economy where ordinary people contribute to robot training through first-person video capture.

entries.title: The Brand Voice File That Makes Claude Code Sound Like You"
entries.summary: A brand-voice.md file added to the Claude Code project root makes the AI match a team's specific writing style, tone, and vocabulary in all outputs. This simple technique eliminates generic AI-sounding text by giving Claude Code persistent brand guidelines per project.

entries.title: Full AI agency with 147 sub-agents in 12 departments for everyone #openai #aiagency #aitech
entries.summary: An open-source GitHub repository has been released featuring 147 specialized AI sub-agents organized into 12 business departments. The system is designed to run all agents in parallel when integrated with cloud coding platforms such as Cursor or Codex.

entries.title: This Free No-Code Tool Creates 3D Websites in Minutes.
entries.summary: Spline, a free browser-based no-code 3D tool, enables building fully interactive 3D websites with smooth animations and clean code in minutes without any coding knowledge. The tool is positioned as a quick way to create premium-looking 3D web experiences.

entries.title: The Claude Expert Speedrun Nobody's Doing
entries.summary: A YouTube Short outlines a 5-day speedrun setup for getting the most out of Claude, covering Projects/memory, personal context, Cowork mode, app integrations, and Claude Code. The creator claims most people use Claude at roughly 10% of its capability and that this no-code roadmap fixes that.

entries.title: Why Nobody Can Beat Magnus Carlsen
I Cant Tell If the Model Matters #Shorts
entries.summary: A commentary argues that when system prompts and context engineering are excellent, the choice of AI model becomes less important as a differentiator. The focus should be on prompt quality before model selection.

entries.title: This Open-Source Repo Uses Claude Code to Automate Your Entire Job Search at Scale
entries.summary: An open-source repository leverages Claude Code to automate job searching at scale, handling the process end-to-end. The project aims to remove manual effort from job hunting using AI-driven automation.

entries.title: One English Video → 12 Languages with Perfect AI Lip Sync | The Future of Video Translation is Here!
entries.summary: A short-form video from aiminds360 promotes AI-powered multilingual video translation with lip synchronization, claiming one English video can be converted into 12 languages. No specific tool or workflow is identified in the available content.

entries.title: Manus launches AI tools for workflow automation and creative asset #Manus #AIworkflow #AIdesign
entries.summary: Manus has revealed three new productivity features: remote computer control via phone, AI-generated marketing assets, and no-code website/app building. The platform also surfaces a skills feature that converts completed tasks into reusable automations.

entries.title: This Claude Extension Changes Everything
entries.summary: The Claude Chrome Extension allows Claude to understand screen content and assist with tasks directly inside Gmail, Notion, Slack, and any website, extending far beyond a standard chat interface. The extension represents a major productivity upgrade for Claude users wanting AI assistance in their existing browser workflows.

entries.title: Only 6% of the context used on this answer  #claudecode
entries.summary: A Claude Code demonstration shows that enabling the "map" feature results in a complex query being answered in 48 seconds while consuming only 6% of the available context window. This highlights Claude Code's context-efficiency capabilities when using its mapping mode.

entries.title: Claude offers unlimited AI image, chat, and video generation with #claude #aiplatform #aigeneration
entries.summary: An AI platform (Claude Max plan) has introduced unlimited image generation with 4K-quality models, unlimited chat with leading LLMs, and AI-driven video creation from product visuals in one integrated platform. It combines image, text, and video AI capabilities for creators and businesses.

entries.title: The ReAct Pattern: How Your AI Agent Actually Thinks #techtok #aiagents
entries.summary: The ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) pattern is explained as the universal loop underlying all modern AI agents: reason → call a tool → observe the result → loop until done. Knowing this pattern instantly clarifies how to debug any stuck, misbehaving, or looping agent.

entries.title: KimiWork launches AI tool with 200K token limit and 300 #kimiwork #aibreakthrough #evmarket
entries.summary: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI launched KimiWork, an agentic AI platform that gained over 90 million users and impressed Elon Musk with its 200,000-token context limit and ability to run 300 parallel agents. It can autonomously produce a detailed 60-page research report with a 14-page presentation in under 20 minutes.

entries.title: 3 Tricks So Claude Code Never Hits Its Limit
entries.summary: Three Claude Code efficiency tricks prevent usage limits: "Opus plans, Sonnet codes" (use /model to assign Opus to planning and Sonnet to execution), /compact to compress long conversations, and the "ultrathink" keyword to trigger deeper pre-coding reasoning. Together these significantly reduce per-session token consumption.

entries.title: This New AI Handles Your ENTIRE Projects For You
entries.summary: A new AI tool is described as autonomously handling entire projects from start to finish. Detailed features and implementation are not available from the title-only content.

entries.title: How Microservices vs Modular Monoliths works #190
entries.summary: A brief software architecture explainer comparing microservices and modular monoliths as architectural patterns. No AI-specific content was covered in this video.

entries.title: These Design.md Files Supercharge Your Coding Agent 🤯 #AI #Coding #DevTools #automation
entries.summary: A technique using DESIGN.md context files in code repositories guides AI coding agents to follow a project's visual design language, color palette, and component patterns when generating UI code. Adding this file to the project root is a lightweight way to enforce design consistency across AI-generated code.

entries.title: MosaicLeaks: Can Your Research Agent Keep a Secret? #Shorts
entries.summary: A YouTube Short teaser from SysLog Daily raises the question of whether AI research agents can keep secrets, referencing a vulnerability called MosaicLeaks. The clip promotes a full episode covering cybersecurity and AI agent privacy concerns.

entries.title: SK Telecom holds massive Anthropic stake amid AI and telecom growth #SKM #AnthropicIPO #AIinvestment
entries.summary: Anthropic filed to go public, spotlighting SK Telecom's $100 million 2023 investment that has grown to an estimated $2.7 billion, representing about 20% of SKM's market cap. This positions SK Telecom as a compelling indirect play on Anthropic's AI growth alongside its core telecom business.

entries.title: Make Free AI Presenter Videos in Google Vids
entries.summary: Google has made AI presenter videos free in Google Vids — upload a Google Slides deck at vids.new and an AI avatar presents it in any of 24 languages. The free tier offers 10 video generations per month with 53 avatar choices, and custom avatars can be built via Nano Banana 2.

entries.title: How Creators Are Getting Millions of Views With AI Animation
entries.summary: AI-generated animation is enabling content creators to amass millions of views without any prior animation knowledge. A wave of creators is reportedly using AI animation tools to produce viral stories and animated content at scale.

entries.title: Comment "Erase" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to wipe your
entries.summary: ChatGPT can be used to automatically find all personal information exposed on data broker and people-search sites and generate exact opt-out links for each. The technique automates what previously required manually visiting hundreds of individual data broker sites.

entries.title: Stop Paying for Claude Code
entries.summary: A GitHub project lets developers use Claude Code's workflow with cheaper alternative models — DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, or local Ollama — by routing requests through a proxy instead of Anthropic's API. The setup takes minutes: install the repo, choose a provider, connect an API key or local model, and start coding at a fraction of the cost.

entries.title: This 65-Line File Made Claude Code 94% Accurate
entries.summary: A 65-line CLAUDE.md rules file placed in the project root has been shown to boost Claude Code accuracy on complex multi-file edits to ~94% by prohibiting three bad habits: silent assumptions, overcomplicating code, and editing unrequested areas. The file is read every Claude Code session and requires no other configuration.

entries.title: Build Dashboards That Don't Look AI Generated
entries.summary: A three-step Claude Code workflow enables building professional dashboards that avoid the generic AI-generated aesthetic: adapt a real dashboard layout as a base, add a custom AI background image as a banner, then animate the interface. The workflow produces premium-looking results in under 10 minutes.

entries.title: Jcode is a fast, memory-efficient open-source AI coding agent built in Rust. #AI #coding #opensource
entries.summary: Jcode is a new open-source AI coding agent built in Rust that achieves 20x better memory efficiency than Claude Code and runs 63x faster than Codex by rebuilding the prompt-handling Harness layer in Rust. It features plug-and-play memory with no setup, native parallel sessions, and support for multiple LLM backends.

entries.title: Picsart MCP + Claude Code = Insane AI Image Automation 🤯 #AI #ClaudeCode #MCP #Automation
entries.summary: Picsart has released an MCP server that integrates directly into Claude Code, enabling automated AI image workflows including background removal, image generation, and effects from within the coding environment. This bridges Picsart's full editing API with Claude Code via the Model Context Protocol.

entries.title: How to Use Claude AI’s Multi-Agent Council for Smarter Decisions
entries.summary: Seb Intel demos a Claude skill called Multi-Agent Council that routes a question through specialist agents (contrarian, strategist, executor) who debate it, with a final synthesis agent delivering a pressure-tested decision. The short video generated 64k+ views with users commenting 'Agent' to receive the skill file.

entries.title: There Has NEVER Been a Better Time to Be a Builder
entries.summary: A 19-second motivational short argues that 2026 is the best time ever to build software products, as AI tools like Claude Code and ChatGPT now let non-programmers turn ideas into websites, apps, and businesses without traditional coding skills. The video offers no specific techniques or demos, serving as a high-level call-to-action for aspiring builders.

entries.title: The Laziest Developer Trick That Saves Thousands
entries.summary: The Ponytail Claude Code skill (nearly 38,000 GitHub stars) forces the AI to check whether code needs to exist before writing it, achieving up to 90% less code and 3–6× faster runs across all Claude model tiers. The free skill installs into Claude Code workflows and cuts costs on every model tested.

entries.title: AI That Builds Dozens of Sites at Once
entries.summary: Omma runs AI agents in parallel on an infinite canvas, allowing users to build dozens of websites or apps simultaneously with commands like "make 50 apps" and deploy all of them live in one click. The tool outputs real editable HTML/CSS and offers a free tier of 50 credits per month.

entries.title: Comment "Canva" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude + Canva is a literal money printer
entries.summary: Claude now integrates directly with Canva through its Connectors system, allowing automated creation of hundreds of branded designs including flyers, carousels, and banners without leaving Claude. Setup takes two minutes via Claude → Customize → Connectors → Canva.

entries.title: Vibe coding tools ranked from Worst to Best || Tier list of vibe coding tools
entries.summary: A 26-second Short ranks seven vibe coding tools from worst to best, listing Claude Code, Codex, Google Antigravity IDE, VS Code, Replit, Cursor, and Lovable with no detailed criteria provided. Comments dispute the ranking, particularly questioning Claude Code's placement.

entries.title: The Software Engineer Hiring Process Is Completely Broken in 2026
Claude Code improves efficiency with Opus model use, chat #ClaudeCode #AIcoding #tokenlimits
entries.summary: Claude Code efficiency improves by using Opus 4.6 for complex planning tasks and Sonnet 4.6 for coding execution, combined with /compact to compress long conversations and "ultra think" to trigger deeper pre-coding analysis. These three techniques collectively reduce excessive token consumption while maintaining accuracy.
